notes: Veeva fiscal year ends Jan 31. Last reported quarter = Q1 FY2027 (ended Apr 30, 2026), announced Jun 3, 2026. Last full FY = FY2026 (ended Jan 31, 2026). KEY VALUATION: stock ~$153, down ~50% from 52-wk high ($310.50) and ~55% from ATH ($343.96, Aug 2021), yet fundamentals are HEALTHY and growing — Q1 FY27 rev +16% YoY, non-GAAP op margin 44.8%, FY27 guidance RAISED to ~$3.64B (~14% growth), FCF margin ~43%, net cash >$7B, no debt. Drop is a valuation de-rating: fwd PE compressed from ~44x (5y avg) to ~16.6x, classic fear/rotation out of high-multiple SaaS (likely AI-disruption sentiment), NOT genuine deterioration -> fear_rotation. SBC verified from FY2026 press release: $472.7M total SBC (note: an earlier aggregator figure of ~$119M was a single-component/quarter misread; full-year SBC is $472.7M). SBC/rev=14.8%, SBC/FCF=34.1% (using FCF $1,386M = OCF $1,415.2M minus capex/long-term assets ~$29.1M). net_debt uses cash+ST investments at Apr 30, 2026 = $7,312.7M (FY2026 year-end was $6,560.8M); Veeva has no debt. ROIC not directly disclosed (left null); nd_ebitda not meaningful (net cash). fwd_pe 16.6 reconciles with FY27 non-GAAP EPS guide ~$9.05 ($153.16/$9.05=16.9). organic_growth ~ reported growth (Veeva grows organically; minimal M&A). 5y avg fwd PE ~44.5 is an aggregator estimate (ESTIMADO); some sources show trailing-PE 5y avg of 60-66x which would imply an even deeper discount.
